scope: Read-only source/evidence assessment; no browser, tests, product edits, data writes, or checkpoint mutation.

Approved workspace: exact scoped lookup completes HTTP 200 with empty result and UI says not saved.

hard_limits.missing_positive_fixture: If no qualifying pre-existing Source exists, read-only saved recognition cannot be proved. Record the empty lookup honestly; do not loop on or retry the reserved Save.
hard_limits.late_save: An old reserved checkpoint is not a live inflight request. No read-only operation can recreate an actual late Save completion. Native late-Save proof requires a separately authorized new mutation scenario with its own fresh fixture/attempt identity; this assessment authorizes none. Keep this dimension unverified while using existing forcing tests only for their engineering scope.
hard_limits.closure: Do not close D22 solely after bounded read-only scope passes. Its recorded closure requires authenticated multi-workspace UI verification. Parent must reconcile the completed engineering evidence with the precise remaining native predicates; broader inventory coverage and native late Save must not be silently relabeled passed.

recommendation: Finish read-only recognition proof on the current build; preserve all existing repairs and the immutable attempt. Treat absence of native proof as an evidence gap, not grounds for another speculative production rewrite.

prepared_runner.build_binding: Requires keyed development build, package/manifest/receipt version agreement, receipt/tree hash agreement before and after run, and shared native harness exact identity validation. Uses actual helper localDevReceiptPath parameter.
prepared_runner.fixture: Observes actual RLS-scoped Saved captures list after real admin sign-in and approved UI workspace selection. Uses a genuine existing HTTPS Source on example.com, www.iana.org, or en.wikipedia.org without query/fragment. Only first visible page searched; no qualifying row yields explicit unverified, never creates one. Source IDs, URLs, row bodies, names and credentials stay in memory.
oracles: Actual scoped HTTP200 response and real Open target identity agreement.
Distinct existing accessible comparison organization selected by UI; corresponding HTTP200 empty or different Source result agrees with UI.

Restore original organization with a fresh scoped read and matching real Open target.
prepared_runner.protocol_evidence: Installed playwright-core/types/protocol.d.ts Fetch.requestPaused documents Response stage and continueRequest as a permitted continuation. Only requestId is supplied; no response/request modification or fulfillment.
prepared_runner.cleanup: Fetch continuation/disable and listener removal in finally, approved workspace restored via UI. Owned profile disposed by native harness.
